name: Baron Vault
win: “Burned. Take the Fire Badge. I’ll invoice you for it later.”
lose: “Money talks. Mine just won the argument.”
hint: Baron Vault’s Fire team is level 41–43. Water and Ground moves put Fire Billies out.

script: [happy] Welcome to Goldvine Town. Everything you can see is mine, and everything you can’t see is in a vault, and also mine. #l:c4ae
I rented the vaults to a pop star. And myself, as it turns out. Read the small print, child. #l:a020
